snippet.title: Liberty City Preservation Project - Official Trailer (read description)
snippet.description:
I ❤️ LC 🗽
https://discord.com/invite/worldtravel

Hey all. Sadly, as I'm sure you're aware, the Liberty City Preservation Project has unfortunately been discontinued. While the mod has NOT been DMCA'd by T2 or Rockstar, all parties involved, including World Travel, mutually agreed to a friendly takedown on the Travel team’s side, resulting in the indefinite removal of the LCPP. There is no bad blood between World Travel and Rockstar/Take-Two. With that in mind, the Discord will remain active as the World Travel Team continues to pursue their passion for modding the Grand Theft Auto series.

Feel free to join the Discord to see what the team does next.
I'm just the guy they had film this video, and it's staying up because I'm DAMN proud of it!

I'd like to give a thank you to all the amazing people on the team for allowing me the opportunity to make this little video for their amazing project!
And of course, a very special thanks to YOU for sticking around and watching the upload! ❤️

Happy Holidays & Happy New Year! Not sure what 2025 will bring, but I hope to see ya there! 🎄🎆

Edited using Vegas Pro
Filmed using R* Editor & OBS
Everything used within this video belongs to its respective owners
